page.content:
Silent commando in black whose visor and sword define the line.

How Snake Eyes connects

  • Faction: G.I. Joe team — Snake Eyes is the silent commando of the G.I. Joe team.
  • Character: Storm Shadow — Snake Eyes and Storm Shadow are Arashikage brothers turned rivals.
  • Character: Scarlett — Scarlett is Snake Eyes's closest partner on the Joe team.
  • Work: G.I. Joe (Marvel comic) — Snake Eyes's silence and origin are central to the Marvel comic.

What is Snake Eyes?

Snake Eyes is the mute ninja commando of the Joe team: a visor, a long sword, an Arashikage past with Storm Shadow, and a file card that made him the face of A Real American Hero.

Key threads lead to G.I. Joe team, Storm Shadow, Scarlett and G.I. Joe (Marvel comic).
